Lessons: How the Bible Is Organised; Creation to Patriarchs; Exodus to the Promised Land; Kings, Prophets and Exile; The Life of Jesus in the Gospels; The Early Church in Acts; Letters That Teach and Encourage; Revelation and the Hope Ahead
Description: Feeling overwhelmed by where to start in the Bible? This friendly tour walks you through all 66 books in order, showing how one big story of God's love holds together from Genesis to Revelation. By the end you will know where everything fits — and where to turn next.
KeyTopics: Creation; Covenant; Redemption; Kingdom of God; Hope
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Exodus; Psalms; Isaiah; Matthew; Acts; Romans; Revelation
